description: Frozen CNN inference parity fixture: harvested Snake states with NumPy-mirror reference actions and logits for two committed DA8 checkpoint exports (one plain, one residual). The mirror is the checkpoint format's declared parity path (float64 accumulation over the stored float32 weights); PyTorch agreement is established by the live check in tools/native_cnn_check.py. Logits are IEEE754 binary32 values rendered as 8 lowercase hex digits. The fixture stands outside native/golden/meta.json's corpus accounting.
regeneration: Regenerate manually with a torch interpreter: python tools/native_cnn_check.py --freeze native/golden/cnn_parity.json (never regenerated by the test suite).
